description: This file defines metrics recording for media remoting sessions, including session start/stop, configuration changes, and performance metrics, with specific focus on video and audio stream properties.

classes.name: SessionMetricsRecorder
classes.description: Records metrics related to remoting sessions, including start/stop triggers, configuration changes, and session durations.

classes.name: RendererMetricsRecorder
classes.description: Records renderer-specific metrics such as initialization time, playout detection, and bitrate estimates.

methods.name: WillStartSession
methods.description: Marks the beginning of a remoting session, recording the trigger and start time.

methods.name: DidStartSession
methods.description: Records metrics when a remoting session successfully starts.

methods.name: StartSessionFailed
methods.description: Records a failure reason for starting a remoting session.

methods.name: WillStopSession
methods.description: Marks the end of a remoting session, recording trigger, duration, and categorizing session length.

methods.name: OnPipelineMetadataChanged
methods.description: Updates and records metrics based on changes in media pipeline metadata, including audio/video configuration.

methods.name: OnRemotePlaybackDisabled
methods.description: Records whether remote playback has been disabled.

methods.name: RecordVideoPixelRateSupport
methods.description: Records support status for video pixel rate.

methods.name: RecordVideoConfiguration
methods.description: Logs current video configuration metrics, including aspect ratio and width.

methods.name: RecordTrackConfiguration
methods.description: Logs whether audio, video, or both streams are active.

methods.name: OnRendererInitialized
methods.description: Records time until renderer is initialized after start.

methods.name: OnEvidenceOfPlayoutAtReceiver
methods.description: Records time until first playout at receiver.
